hypothesis: Does equal-weight per-layer plus fused-context source alignment improve retargeted DFlash over context-only fitting at matched data, sampled positions and updates?
scope: User-proposed loss. Four declared architecture/objective controls, no independent confirmation. Fixed192token cache prefixes,32 sampled positions per record,2048position batches. Frozen 8192-update baseline is a deployment reference with a different fitting budget. All lanes540seconds.
loss: mean_n_i ||Wi xi - yi||^2/(||yi||^2+1e-6) + mean_n ||RMSNorm(F concat(Wi xi))-RMSNorm(F concat(yi))||^2/(||c||^2+1e-6)
normalization: Frozen source RMSNorm scale and epsilon1e-6. No input normalization in five-map arms. Existing dense context control keeps input RMS normalization.
caveat: The proposal changes both parameterization and loss. Context-only same-parameterization control isolates layer supervision; dense context is matched-budget original architecture. Not a recreation of512/4k rollout lengths.
